documents.text: Ipi Morea (born 6 May 1975) is a Papua New Guinean cricketer. A right-handed batsman and wicket-keeper, he played for the Papua New Guinea national cricket team between 2000 and 2005. Born in Port Moresby in 1975, Ipi Morea first played for Papua New Guinea in the 2000 ACC Trophy in Malaysia. This was followed the next year by an appearance in the 2001 ICC Trophy, also in Malaysia and a second ACC Trophy, in Nepal, in 2002.
